interface.title: hydro-efficiency-api (Swagger UI at /docs) — 水效评估, 工业园区水效评估 (AHP + CRITIC + TOPSIS)
interface.field: Environmental engineering / industrial water management (water-use efficiency of industrial parks)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and reporting: turning yearly park, pipeline-network and enterprise water data into weighted indicator scores, enterprise rankings and an Excel report
interface.what_it_is_for: Scoring how efficiently an industrial park and its enterprises use and reuse water: it computes indicators C1–C10 at three levels (大循环/小循环/点循环, i.e. park-wide, pipeline network, enterprise), blends AHP and CRITIC weights through an alpha setting, ranks enterprises with TOPSIS into four grades (领跑/先进/达标/待改进), and returns JSON or an Excel report.

data.note: Most runs used the server's built-in sample (use_sample=true). One run uploaded the test file efficiency_sample.xlsx with use_sample=false. That file holds the same data as the built-in sample: 4 years (2023–2026) of park-wide and pipeline data and 5 enterprises (久立集团, 永兴材料, 诺力股份, 美欣达集团, 长城电工) for 2024–2026. So the upload run cannot prove the server read the file rather than the built-in data. The Streamlit UI described in the README is not in this commit; the only interface is FastAPI's auto-generated Swagger page with 4 endpoints, and charts arrive only as JSON chart data, never drawn. Setup: before analysis the service can be checked with GET /api/health ({"status":"ok"}) and GET /api/meta (title 水效评估, description 工业园区水效评估 (AHP + CRITIC + TOPSIS), v1.0.0); both worked in the run and the replay (screens/003.webp, screens/005.webp).

features.name: Subjective/objective weight blending with a mixing-parameter input and side-by-side weight table
features.general: Combine expert-assigned criterion weights with data-derived weights using one mixing parameter, and see each criterion's expert, data and combined weight side by side
features.specific: Set alpha (AHP 权重占比, a number field, 0–1, default 0.5); response gives 权重详情 / charts.weights with AHP权重, CRITIC权重 and 组合权重 = alpha·AHP + (1−alpha)·CRITIC for C1–C10, plus 层面权重 for 大/小/点循环
steps: Enter an alpha between 0 and 1
Run the computation
Read the per-criterion AHP / CRITIC / combined weights
Change alpha (e.g. 0, 0.3, 1) and re-run to compare
Values outside 0–1 are rejected with a validation message
serves_tasks: Read each criterion's expert, data-derived and combined weight
Find out what happens with an out-of-range weight balance

features.name: TOPSIS closeness ranking with grade colour codes
features.general: Rank items by closeness to an ideal solution, turn the closeness into a 0–100 score and assign each item a named grade with a warning colour code, then count items per grade
features.specific: TOPSIS企业评价(latest year) table: 企业名称, 相对贴近度, 水效评分, 水效等级, 预警颜色 (hex strings in the JSON: 水效领跑 #1890ff / 水效先进 #52c41a / 水效达标 #faad14 / 水效待改进 #f5222d), plus charts.gradeDistribution counts
steps: Run the computation with a chosen alpha
Read enterprises sorted by relative closeness
Read each one's score, grade and colour code
Read the grade distribution counts for a pie or bar chart
serves_tasks: Run the full scoring pipeline and get a baseline ranking
See how the grades are spread across facilities

features.name: Pairwise-judgment consistency check
features.general: Check whether an expert's pairwise-comparison matrix is consistent enough to trust before using its weights
features.specific: AHP判断矩阵 sheet → meta.cr (0.0070) and meta.consistent (true); repeated in X-Cr / X-Consistent response headers when downloading xlsx
steps: Supply a workbook with an AHP判断矩阵 sheet (or use the sample)
Run the computation
Read CR and the consistent flag in meta (JSON) or in the response headers (xlsx)
serves_tasks: Check that the expert pairwise-judgment matrix is consistent enough to use

features.name: Data source switch: built-in example vs uploaded workbook, with template download and echoed derived indicators
features.general: Run an analysis either on a bundled example dataset or on your own spreadsheet, with a downloadable template to copy the expected layout, and see the raw sheets and the indicators derived from them
features.specific: GET /api/sample downloads efficiency_sample.xlsx; POST /api/compute takes either use_sample=true or a file (大循环/小循环/点循环-YYYY年/AHP判断矩阵 sheets); the preview block echoes the raw sheets and the per-level indicators derived from them (macro_raw, macro_indicators, meso_raw/indicators, micro_raw/indicators_by_year). Caveats: the only uploaded file was identical to the sample, and use_sample=false with no file silently falls back to the sample data with a 200 response (api.py:368)
steps: Download the sample workbook as a template
Choose use_sample=true, or attach your own xlsx with use_sample=false
Run
Check the preview tables to confirm the sheets were read as expected
serves_tasks: Get a template copy of the example input workbook
Check the derived indicator values for each year

features.name: Dual-format result export (JSON payload or Excel report)
features.general: Get the same analysis either as structured JSON (tables plus chart-ready series plus the embedded report) or as a downloadable spreadsheet report
features.specific: format=json returns preview, meta, results, charts and xlsxBase64; format=xlsx (any other value) returns efficiency_result.xlsx with X-Years/X-Cr/X-Consistent/X-Enterprises/X-Latest-Year headers; Swagger's Download and copy buttons save the JSON
steps: Set format to json or xlsx
Run
For json: scroll, copy or download the body
For xlsx: click Download file and read the summary headers
serves_tasks: Download the spreadsheet report, or save the full machine-readable result

features.name: Three-level weighted scoring with level weights
features.general: Score a system at several nested levels (whole site, distribution network, member facilities) per year on a 0–100 scale, and combine the levels with level weights into one composite score
features.specific: 分层评分与试点汇总: 大循环 / 小循环 / 点循环 scores per year (2026 at alpha 0.5: 80.86 / 41.75 / 51.11) and the 汇总评分; 层面权重 / charts.layerWeights change with alpha (0.4689 / 0.1967 / 0.3344 at 0.5; 0.635 / 0.1794 / 0.1856 at 1)
steps: Run the computation with a chosen alpha
Read the per-level scores for each year
Read the level weights used to combine them
Change alpha and re-run to see the level weights shift
serves_tasks: Read the yearly scores for the whole site, the distribution network and the member facilities, and the weights that combine them
